info.summary: Mokhotsi shop API: users, shops, catalogue, sales and device sync.

post.summary: Register as a shop owner (signed in at once; waits for the admin's approval)
post.description: Creates a pending owner, registers this phone and signs the owner in. Until a system admin approves the registration the owner has no permissions, and GET /users/me shows `status: pending`. A phone number can be registered once (`phone_taken`).

409.description: Conflicts with current state (e.g. duplicate email)

post.summary: Sign in with a PIN, get a device token, or rotate a refresh token
post.description:
OAuth2-style token endpoint (RFC 6749 §5.1: success is 200, responses are not cached).
- `pin`: phone + PIN (owners, admins). Without a device credential the phone is registered and its secret returned once in `device`.
- `device_pin`: a registered phone + shop + PIN (anyone in the shop).
- `device`: a registered phone's credential, for a device token (sync, roster).
- `refresh_token`: rotates the refresh token. Reusing a spent one revokes the session.

post.summary: Apply up to 200 outbox ops from this phone (idempotent by op_id)
post.description: Each op is acked or rejected with a code; one bad op never fails the batch. Acked ops that need the owner's attention (e.g. a sale by a removed cashier) are also listed in `flagged`. An op_id that was already applied is acked again without being re-applied.

record.title: Record
record.description: The current state of the record, not the op

device_id.title: Device Id
device_id.description: The one phone whose offline data seeds this shop

vector_f16.title: Vector F16
vector_f16.description: Base64 of `dim` little-endian IEEE-754 binary16 values (L2-normalised)

IssuedDevice.title: IssuedDevice
IssuedDevice.description: Returned once, when a phone is registered. Store the secret in the phone's keystore.

MemberCreate.title: MemberCreate
MemberCreate.description:
Creates a new cashier account and adds it to the shop. The PIN must be unique in the shop:
it alone identifies the cashier at the till.

NewDevice.title: NewDevice
NewDevice.description: A phone signing in for the first time: it is registered and gets a credential.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: The record for `entity` (Product, Sale, Reversal, StockMovement, Embedding); for an embedding delete, {id}.

existing.title: Existing
existing.description: The shop already has this image: nothing to upload

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Send these form fields unchanged, plus `file`

urls.title: Urls
urls.description: null: the shop has no such image (yet)

temporary_pin.title: Temporary Pin
temporary_pin.description: Shown once. Pass it on; it must be changed at sign-in.

device_id.title: Device Id
device_id.description: Must be the device of the token

flagged.title: Flagged
flagged.description: Acked ops recorded for the owner to review

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: The shop's latest seq after this push

RegistrationCreate.title: RegistrationCreate
RegistrationCreate.description: A shop owner signs up. They can sign in at once but do nothing until approved.

ReviewCreate.title: ReviewCreate
ReviewCreate.description: The admin's decision on a pending owner. A rejection should say why.

pin_tag.title: Pin Tag
pin_tag.description: HMAC-SHA256(pin_key, PIN), hex. Null until the member's PIN is set again.

pin_key.title: Pin Key
pin_key.description: Base64. Keep it in the phone's keystore, never in SQLite

members.title: Members
members.description: Active people who may sign in

ShopCreate.title: ShopCreate
ShopCreate.description:
An approved owner opens a shop. Their PIN confirms it is them and becomes their PIN in
the new shop; the phone they are using is registered to the shop.

ShopUpdate.title: ShopUpdate
ShopUpdate.description: Owners rename their shops; only a system admin changes the status.

after.title: After
after.description: Pass back as ?after= for the next page

snapshot_seq.title: Snapshot Seq
snapshot_seq.description: Continue with pull from this cursor

id.title: Id
id.description: The phone's id for the issue: a report sent twice is kept once

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: rejected: the server refused a change; flagged: it was kept but needs a look; conflict: a change from another phone did not fit this phone's data

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: Stored, or already stored: the phone may forget them

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Single use: every refresh returns a new one

device.description: Only when this request registered the phone

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description:
An admin adds an owner or another admin directly (already approved).

The response carries a temporary PIN to pass on; it must be changed at first sign-in.
Cashiers are created by their shop's owner (POST /shops/{id}/members).

temporary_pin.title: Temporary Pin
temporary_pin.description: Shown once. The user must change it at sign-in.

HTTPBearer.description: Access or device token from POST /api/v1/tokens
